request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; specific milestones include 52 weeks ongoing maintenance/support, 20 weeks CIP-30, 12 weeks hardware wallet support, 8 weeks architecture assessment, and architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node and wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, platform support, release engineering, dependency/security maintenance, and signed releases
Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, plus newer hardware wallet models as they emerge during the contract period
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus with documentation and dApp interoperability verification
Japanese localisation and Japanese-language user support alongside general user support
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect administration and milestone-based disbursement
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet and derives wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, with the true count asserted to be higher due to privacy-conscious users being less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and has shipped Mithril snapshot bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, the drt release CLI, and Nix build modernization.
The proposal commits to providing a compatible stable Daedalus release at least two weeks before every mainnet hard fork during the contract period.
All release-timing and version-currency success metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain without reliance on applicant self-reporting.
The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, consisting of 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and a 52,000 ADA Intersect administration fee.
Any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
Intersect will administer the funds, verify milestones, authorize monthly disbursements against verified work, and hold funds in a dedicated account auditable by the Cardano community.
The requested amount does not at submission breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

Se7en Labs states it has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months and that its current Daedalus maintenance funding is through a direct IOG contract ending August 31, 2026.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for a time-and-materials public-good maintenance and improvement engagement for Daedalus, with stated deliverables around protocol compatibility, release security, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, localisation, support, and architecture assessment, administered through Intersect with milestone-based disbursement.
